task_text: Wash the dirty dishes and utensils, make the bed

central_instructions.R1: Wash the dirty dishes and utensils in the kitchen using your gripper.
central_instructions.R2: Assist R1 by passing clean dishes and utensils to R3 or R4 if needed.
central_instructions.R3: Make the bed in the bedroom.
central_instructions.R4: Assist R3 in making the bed or organizing the bedroom as needed.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the dish sponge from the sink basin (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Wash the mug in the sink basin using the dish sponge (r1_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Wash the fork in the sink basin using the dish sponge (r1_s3)

[15-20 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Wash the spoon in the sink basin using the dish sponge (r1_s4)

[20-25 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the cleaned mug, fork, and spoon on the drying rack (r1_s5)
